c_aboutBody:
KATTED24 is an Estonian company that manufactures and repairs PVC covers for both business clients (mainly industry and agriculture) and private customers. Our core products include tarpaulins for truck trailers and durable partition curtains for production and warehouse spaces, which help separate work areas, keep rooms clean and ensure safety. 

We also produce and service every other PVC cover solution there is, from a sandbox cover to fully bespoke projects. Our strength lies in long experience, precise measurements and reliable materials that give every cover a long life and deliver exactly the result the customer wanted. 

 
“Katted24 was born out of a desire to do something better in the world of PVC covers. Our team combines years of experience with genuine dedication, so that every customer gets a solution that lasts, that works, and that is truly something to be proud of.”

c_solutionBodies:
We make durable, waterproof PVC covers for every domestic need that requires protection from Estonia's changeable weather. Whether you have a garden house, a sandbox, a grill, a smoker, garden furniture, a pool, a hot tub or any other object that needs a solid cover – we make it exactly to your measurements. 

Covers keep your household belongings dry and clean and extend their life, offering year-round protection that is both attractive and practical.
c_solutionTitles: PVC covers to protect your home and garden

c_solutionBodies:
We produce a variety of PVC curtains suitable for both production and warehouse spaces. The range includes standard PVC curtains, film curtains and mesh curtains, which let more light into the space and provide better air circulation. 

We also make welding curtains, which protect work areas from sparks, light and heat and meet industrial safety requirements. 

All curtains are made to exact measurements, so that the solution fits the intended space and purpose perfectly.

Trust your PVC covers to us – we repair everything made of PVC fabric. Whether it is trailer covers, PVC halls, trampolines, water tubes, inflatable boats, party tents or other leisure products such as rally arches, start and finish arches and inflatable attractions – we give them a new life. 

During a repair we can fit new zips, straps and fastenings, reinforce worn edges where needed and restore everything that helps extend the working life of the cover or product. We do the work exactly according to your needs and the particulars of the object.

We make PVC tarpaulins and load covers to exact measurements for all trailers and containers, giving the load solid protection in any situation. You get the complete solution from us: where needed we replace straps, tubes, tensioners, rollers, roof plastics and everything else required for the cover to work flawlessly. 

Spare parts can also be bought on site if you prefer to fit them yourself later. We also offer the option to personalise a trailer or container by applying a logo, text or other designs to the cover in paint or with stickers. That way the vehicle becomes not only practical but also visually distinctive.

In the construction sector PVC covers are a practical and durable solution that adapts to very different situations. We make partition curtains for production and warehouse spaces, new curtains for canopies, and covering solutions for sheds and containers that need protection on a construction site. 

We also produce room-dividing PVC curtains for laundries and workshops, helping to keep work processes clean, safe and separated. 

For construction sites we also make lifting covers, with which various materials or objects can be lifted conveniently and safely. Our covers have even been used for lifting snow, to save the workers' effort. 

PVC covers are also excellent for protecting equipment and tools from rain, wind, sun and snow – a solid cover significantly extends their life and keeps the site tidy and safe.

PVC halls need regular maintenance to stay reliable and last a long time. We recommend servicing a hall 3–4 times a year and always after major storms, because the weather is what affects the condition of the covers most. That is exactly what we do – complete aftercare for PVC halls all over Estonia. 

Where necessary we replace the hall covers, repair damage, retension the cover, check the cables, bolts, ground anchors and fastenings, and carry out all the other work that keeps the hall structure safe. We also recommend a visual inspection every year, to spot wear early and make sure the cover is properly taut. 

If you wish, we add ventilation openings to the hall, which improve air circulation and reduce the build-up of moisture. In windy weather the door of a PVC hall must always be kept closed – an open door raises the internal pressure and can tear the roof or the curtains. 

All physical damage should be repaired immediately, because later it can grow many times larger and more expensive. Our team services and repairs PVC halls all over Estonia, providing fast and professional help.

PVC covers are indispensable in the daily work of farmers and foresters, giving durable protection to equipment, machinery and large-scale work sites alike. We make and repair PVC halls, canopies, sheds, container covers and trailer covers that stand up to intensive use and changeable weather. 

We also produce PVC fabric tubes and bellows, tractor underbody covers, various ground sheets and slurry tank covers that help keep equipment and materials dry, clean and protected. Because agricultural and forestry equipment is often large, we come to the customer anywhere in Estonia to take exact measurements or carry out the necessary repairs on site. 

For foresters and farmers we also make the popular covers for moving-floor trailers. We prepare these for stock as well, so that we can react quickly and supply a new cover without a long wait. 

Our aim is to make sure every PVC cover works faultlessly and extends the life of the equipment – whether the job is forestry, farming or transport.

Our PVC covers are also used in the defence industry, where durable and dependable solutions are needed for vehicles, equipment and buildings alike. Every defence industry order is made to exceptional precision, and we use FR-rated (fire resistance) PVC materials, which means slower ignition and better fire resistance – exactly what NATO standards require. 

We always produce defence industry covers as a priority, to do our part for Estonia's national defence. It matters to us that defence sector equipment and facilities are covered by solutions that withstand extreme conditions and intensive use.

PVC covers are the ideal solution for every recreational vehicle, offering both transport and storage protection all year round. We make covers to exact measurements for motorboats, yachts, snowmobiles, lawn tractors, motorcycles, ATVs and many other machines that need protection from rain, sun, wind or snow. 

We also produce ground sheets for motorsport equipment, such as rally service park floor covers that stop oil and other fluids from reaching the environment. Our covers have been in use at several rally competitions, where we have always supported young rally drivers whenever we could. 

PVC covers are also excellent in front of sheds and carports where recreational vehicles are kept year-round. That keeps the machinery clean, dry and protected, whatever the weather.

We carry out a range of metalwork and welding, so that we can offer the customer a complete solution for trailers and other structures alike. We build new frames, modify and reinforce existing frames and, where needed, make new PVC covers for them. 

We also do metalwork on trailers, to give the covers a better fit, greater reliability and easier use. That way you get the whole solution from one place – a strong frame, a quality cover and professional installation that supports long-term use of the cover.
c_solutionTitles: A complete solution for trailers and structures

c_solutionBodies:
Alongside industrial PVC covers we also make PVC banners — something many of our customers may not yet know about. Our banners are used by a number of advertising agencies that value the durability, weather resistance and good print quality of PVC material. 

We do not design posters or advertisements ourselves, but if you already have a design in a vector file, you can send it to us and we will put together a quick, specific quote. All enquiries are welcome at info@katted24.ee. 

PVC banners work excellently at events, on construction sites, in advertising campaigns and as permanent outdoor advertising – the strong material withstands wind, rain and sun.

In addition to manufacturing covers, we also offer customers the option to buy PVC fabric straight off the roll, with no processing at all. This is a service many customers may not yet know about, but it allows them to make smaller covers themselves, repair existing ones or use PVC material in other projects. 

We also sell all the spare parts we use in our own daily work – straps, tubes, tensioners, rollers, zips, fastenings, roof plastics and much more. All of these components are available separately, so that customers can carry out maintenance themselves or upgrade their own covers when needed. 

If you have questions about materials or spare parts, do get in touch – we will help you find exactly what you need.
c_solutionTitles: PVC fabric and spare parts for sale

frequentlyAskedQuestions.answer:
Every project is different, which is why we can only give an exact quote once we have the necessary information. Please send us: 

• Measurements – Precise measurements ensure correct pricing and a properly fitting end result. 

• A sketch or drawing – A simple hand-drawn sketch works perfectly. 

• Photos of the place or object you need a cover for – Ideally 2–3 pictures from different angles, so we understand the context and any special features. 

• Preferred colour – Colour affects both the choice of material and the final price.
frequentlyAskedQuestions.question: How pricing works

frequentlyAskedQuestions.answer:
Ordering is simple and quick. To guarantee an exact result, the process runs through the following steps: 

 

• Sharing the information – The customer sends us the measurements, 2–3 photos of the installation site and the preferred colour. A sketch or drawing can be added if you wish. 

• Clarification with our craftsman – Our craftsman contacts the customer to go through the measurements, special features and all the important details together before work begins. 

• Confirming the completion date – Once all the details are settled, the craftsman gives an approximate completion date and the cover goes into production.
frequentlyAskedQuestions.question: The ordering process

frequentlyAskedQuestions.answer:
Precise measurements are the basis of a quality result. If the customer is not sure how to measure, there are two options: 

• Phone guidance – Our craftsman explains step by step over the phone how to take the required measurements correctly, ensuring an exact fit and a clean end result. 

• On-site measuring – If you prefer, we come to you and take the measurements professionally. The price of this service is agreed in advance and depends on the location of the object.
frequentlyAskedQuestions.question: The measuring process

frequentlyAskedQuestions.answer: Smaller parcels are sent to parcel lockers across Estonia. Larger products travel either to a Cargobus office or by Jet Express courier straight to your home or factory. The shipping method depends on the size and weight of the product — we always find the most convenient solution.
frequentlyAskedQuestions.question: How do shipping and transport work?

frequentlyAskedQuestions.question: How thick and durable is the cover?

frequentlyAskedQuestions.answer: All covers are waterproof or water-repellent, matching the customer's needs and the place of use.
frequentlyAskedQuestions.question: Is the cover waterproof?

frequentlyAskedQuestions.question: Does the cover withstand UV radiation?

frequentlyAskedQuestions.answer: A cover needs very little maintenance. We recommend cleaning it with a damp cloth or a mild detergent. Regular care significantly extends the life of the cover.

frequentlyAskedQuestions.answer: All of our materials are suitable for year-round use.
frequentlyAskedQuestions.question: Is the cover suitable for year-round use?

frequentlyAskedQuestions.answer: The more precise the measurements, the better the result. If the customer is not sure how to measure, you can always call – our craftsman will guide you step by step. If you prefer, we can also come and take the measurements ourselves (price by agreement).
frequentlyAskedQuestions.question: How precise do the measurements need to be?

frequentlyAskedQuestions.answer: Production time depends on the complexity of the work and our current queue. On average it takes 1–3 working days. The craftsman confirms the exact completion date after reviewing the measurements and details.
frequentlyAskedQuestions.question: How long does production take?

frequentlyAskedQuestions.answer: Yes – all of our work is made to order. We can produce covers in any size and shape.
frequentlyAskedQuestions.question: Do you also make custom-shaped or non-standard covers?

frequentlyAskedQuestions.answer: Yes – we have the largest selection of colours and materials in Estonia. If the customer is not sure which material suits best, our craftsman will help choose the most durable and suitable option.
frequentlyAskedQuestions.question: Can I choose the colour and material?

frequentlyAskedQuestions.answer: If the product requires installation, we can carry it out for you. Availability and price depend on the location and the nature of the work.
frequentlyAskedQuestions.question: Do you install the cover yourselves?

frequentlyAskedQuestions.answer:
Yes – we make covers both to exact measurements and on the basis of an existing old cover. If you want a new cover made from an old one, it is important that the old cover is in as intact a condition as possible. Over time some materials shrink in the sun, so please always specify whether you want the new cover in exactly the same size or rather slightly larger, so that it fits perfectly. 

 

If you are located further from Tallinn, that is no problem – you can conveniently send the old cover to us. We work with Cargobus and Jet Express couriers, who deliver parcels safely to us and later bring the new covers back to your address.
